subject: synthetic-code-claimed-different-issuer
why: a synthetic fixture proving that the reciprocity rule refuses a code-only match: the issuer's home_domain (impersonation.example) publishes a stellar.toml that claims AQUA under a different issuer. Claims() requires both code AND issuer to match, so accountability is unverified even though the toml names the same asset code. This is the impersonation shape the reciprocity check exists to catch (#379).
